field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the DS-Lite / Fixed IP IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel.

field.label: Mode
field.help: DS-Lite uses shared IPv4 via CG-NAT. Fixed IP uses a dedicated public IPv4 address (requires ISP subscription).

field.label: ISP Profile
field.help: Select your ISP service. In DS-Lite mode this sets the AFTR address automatically. In Fixed IP mode it also selects how the provider's Interface ID is mapped into the tunnel address: transix and enabler supply it as the low 64 bits, others as a subnet selector. Leave on Auto to detect from the delegated prefix, or from the BR address in Fixed IP mode.

field.label: WAN Interface
field.help: Select the WAN interface with IPv6 connectivity (DHCPv6).

field.label: AFTR Hostname
field.help: AFTR hostname for DNS resolution. Used when ISP profile is "Custom".

field.label: AFTR IPv6 Address
field.help: Static AFTR IPv6 address. Leave empty to resolve from hostname or use ISP profile default.

field.label: B4 IPv4 Address
field.help: Local tunnel IPv4 address (RFC 6333 default: 192.0.0.2).

field.label: AFTR IPv4 Address
field.help: Remote tunnel IPv4 address (RFC 6333 default: 192.0.0.1).

field.label: Tunnel Interface
field.help: The gif unit the tunnel is built on. Default gif0. Change this only if another GIF tunnel already holds that unit — the plugin refuses to take over an interface it did not create, and logs which unit is in the way.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Tunnel interface MTU. Default 1460 (1500 - 40 byte IPv6 header).

field.label: TCP MSS Clamp
field.help: TCP Maximum Segment Size clamping value. Default 1420.

field.label: Enable NAT
field.help: Enable IPv4 NAT (masquerade) on the tunnel interface. Required for DS-Lite, optional for Fixed IP.

field.label: Interface ID (IPv6)
field.help: Your assigned Interface ID in full IPv6 format (e.g., ::feed or 0000:0000:0000:feed). Used to derive the tunnel source address for transix/enabler. Not used by xpass.

field.label: AFTR Endpoint (IPv6)
field.help: Your assigned AFTR endpoint IPv6 address.

field.label: Fixed IPv4 Address
field.help: Your assigned fixed public IPv4 address.

field.label: Prefix Update URL
field.help: URL for periodic prefix updates (e.g., https://v6update.asahi-net.or.jp/prefix).

field.label: Auth User ID
field.help: Authentication user ID for prefix updates.

field.label: Auth Password
field.help: Authentication password for prefix updates.

field.label: MAP-E Profile
field.help: Fills in the values that are the same for every subscriber on that service (BR address, PSID offset). The mapping rule below is still per-subscriber.

field.label: MAP-E BR Address
field.help: IPv6 address of the Border Relay. Left blank, the profile supplies it.

field.label: MAP-E Rule IPv6 Prefix
field.help: Rule IPv6 prefix in CIDR form, e.g. 240b:10::/31. Your delegated prefix must fall inside it — if it does not, the tunnel refuses to come up rather than guess a wrong port set.

field.label: MAP-E Rule IPv4 Prefix
field.help: Rule IPv4 prefix in CIDR form, e.g. 106.72.0.0/15.

field.label: MAP-E EA-bits Length
field.help: Number of Embedded Address bits, e.g. 25. The PSID length is derived as EA length minus (32 - IPv4 prefix length).

field.label: MAP-E PSID Offset
field.help: PSID offset. RFC 7597 defaults to 6; v6plus uses 4. Left blank, the profile or the RFC default applies.

field.label: Allow Insecure Update URL
field.help: By default the prefix update is only sent over HTTPS with full certificate verification, and is refused otherwise. Enable this only if your ISP publishes no HTTPS endpoint (for example OCN Fixed IP, which uses plain http://). Your username and password will then be readable by anyone on the path.

field.label: DDNS ID
field.help: Your DDNS ID from xpass provisioning email. Used in the update request.

field.label: DDNS Password
field.help: Your DDNS password from xpass provisioning email. Used in the update request.

field.label: FQDN
field.help: Your FQDN from xpass provisioning email. Used in the update request.
